order: actual CPU, local TSC-before, point ID; never compare TSC differences across CPUs
pair: earliest remaining eligible point, earliest later eligible point reaching target and strictly after its bracket; evaluate interval only after choosing end; consume through end
errors: missing publication/ID, duplicate ID, mixed domain, equal/reversed/overlapping local brackets, backward HPET or overflow fail construction; no partial authoritative output
history: legacy worker-window captures retain their original checker and verdict; offline pooling is test-only
